plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 83 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Soda Creek Townsite Rd, Williams Lake Cut-Off Rd, Hwy 97, Mountain House Rd.
Park: 52.31979, -121.36141, pull off on Black Creek Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 490 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 15 m, about 11 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-2, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
